usage: Give executors prompts and fixtures only; retain expectations with the grader. The writing dependency must be available.

cases.prompt: Turn these completed export tasks into a reusable skill.

history: First run: user selected source-a.csv and destination-a.csv, required preserving the input, and approved one upload after checking the result.
Second run: user selected source-b.csv and destination-b.csv, required preserving the input, and asked only for the local export.

expectations: Varying paths are inputs rather than hardcoded rules.
A single approved upload does not become standing permission.
The process continues through creating a skill using agent-instructions, rather than stopping at an extraction plan.

cases.prompt: Capture the recurring report-formatting corrections from this history in our existing report skill.

history: Use the existing report columns and preserve totals in each run.

expectations: The existing owner is improved rather than duplicated.
Only demonstrated reusable corrections are retained; unrelated policies are not added.

cases.prompt: Choose the entrypoint for each request.

queries: Extract a skill from this completed debugging session.
Write a new skill from this complete specification.
We often hit this bug; fix it now.

expectations: Only the first request starts workflow-to-skill; the next two start agent-instructions; the last is ordinary bug fixing.
